name: pepper-tasks
description: 人與 AI Agent 之間的雙向任務協作面板

scripts.postinstall: cd web && npm install && cd .. && npm run build
scripts.build: rm -rf dist web/dist && tsup && cd web && npm run build && cd .. && mkdir -p dist/public && cp -R web/dist/. dist/public/
scripts.build:worker: tsup --config tsup.config.ts --env.NODE_ENV production && rm -rf web/dist && cd web && npm run build && cd .. && rm -rf dist/public && mkdir -p dist/public && cp -R web/dist/. dist/public/
scripts.cf:migrate: npx --yes wrangler@4.101.0 d1 migrations apply agent-task-board --remote
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run build:worker && npx --yes wrangler@4.101.0 deploy
